# E2E Testing Patterns

Curated by Skill Harbor: comprehensive Playwright patterns for building stable, fast, and maintainable end-to-end test suites. Covers test file organization (grouping specs by auth, features, and API, with shared fixtures), the Page Object Model with locator-based page classes and data-testid selectors instead of brittle CSS, Playwright configuration, CI/CD integration, artifact management (traces, screenshots, videos on failure), and above all the strategies that kill flaky tests: proper wait conditions, networkidle discipline, and test isolation. Written as ready-to-adapt TypeScript, so an agent can scaffold a suite or refactor an unstable one directly. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: Playwright and Node.js focused; you need a running app to test against, and the flaky-test fixes assume you control the test environment (CI runners with enough resources). Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
